value.title: Release gate — harness 0.14.0
value.summary:
A release gate authored as a deterministic document.
The schema, its adapters and this file all live in one folder — nothing here resolves through the repository root.

value.claim: Every public CLI verb has a frozen surface row and a test that pins it.
The published package installs clean from the registry, not merely from a local pack.
value.note: proxy lag means a green tag is not a published package

value.claim: Telemetry payloads carry counts only — no file contents, no prompts, no secrets.
value.receipt: Jordan, 2026-08-04: waived for this release — the allowlist gate landed in 0.13.2 and has not moved since.

value.claim: Every how-to page renders its own worked example rather than describing one.
value.note: three pages still describe a corpus instead of shipping it

value.claim: The upgrade path from 0.13.x is proven on a real checkout, not reasoned about.
